name: darrow-goal-loop
description: Adaptive Goal Loop: compile bounded engineering requests and activate host-native goals on verified routes

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive Goal Loop for host-native goals
interface.longDescription: Adaptive Goal Loop prepares a bounded engineering request, compiles an observable goal contract, loads the selected workflow playbook and risk gate, selects and applies a proportionate model and effort, and activates native goal mode with harness-verifiable workflow and route evidence.
defaultPrompt: Preflight this bounded engineering request and activate it as one host-native goal.
